parsed.summary: The power train, I2C/isolation architecture, TMC2209 drivers, and pump/valve switches match the specification, but the float-switch pull resistors are swapped relative to the reference design (R6 pull-up on FLOAT_HIGH, R9 pull-down on FLOAT_LOW), which leaves the low-water float interlock unable to assert and disables the low-level pump cutoff; the LiDAR is also wired to the I2C bus contrary to the spec's statement that it is unconnected.
